sql_query:
WITH
order_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id AS customer_u,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
payments AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id AS customer_u,
    SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
items AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id AS customer_u,
    COUNT(oi.order_id) AS total_items_ordered
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
reviews AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id AS customer_u,
    AVG(orv.review_score) AS average_review_score
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_reviews orv ON o.order_id = orv.order_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT
  oc.customer_u AS customer_u,
  oc.order_count,
  COALESCE(p.total_revenue, 0.0) AS total_revenue,
  CASE WHEN oc.order_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(p.total_revenue, 0.0) / oc.order_count ELSE NULL END AS average_order_value,
  COALESCE(i.total_items_ordered, 0) AS total_items_ordered,
  r.average_review_score
FROM order_counts oc
LEFT JOIN payments p USING (customer_u)
LEFT JOIN items i USING (customer_u)
LEFT JOIN reviews r USING (customer_u)
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;
